category.name: Speech and audio
category.description: Text-to-speech, speech-to-text, voice cloning, dubbing and audio intelligence.

entries.name: Amazon Polly / Amazon Transcribe (AWS)
entries.auth_hint: AWS SigV4 signing with IAM access keys
entries.free_tier: Free tier: Polly 5M chars/mo standard (neural 1M, generative 100K chars/mo for first 12 months), Transcribe 60 min/mo (12 months); new AWS accounts since 2025-07-15 get up to $200 Free Tier credits
entries.desc_en: Convert text to lifelike speech (Polly) and transcribe audio with speaker diarization (Transcribe) via AWS API.
entries.notes: Needs an AWS account and IAM credentials. Voice and feature availability differs by region. Transcribe docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/what-is.html. The generic AWS API MCP Server (awslabs) runs AWS CLI commands, incl. polly and transcribe.

free_plan.quota: Polly: 5M standard chars/month (neural 1M for first 12 months); Transcribe: 60 min/month for 12 months

auth_scheme.format: AWS Signature Version 4 (Authorization: AWS4-HMAC-SHA256 ...) signed with IAM credentials

data_policy.summary: Transcribe may store and use voice inputs to improve AWS AI services; opt out via AWS Organizations AI services opt-out policy

unit_price.summary: Polly: standard $4.00, neural $16.00, generative $30.00, long-form $100.00 per 1M characters (beyond free tier)

entries.name: AssemblyAI API
entries.free_tier: Trial: $50 in free credits one-time on signup, no card required, credits do not expire (LLM Gateway not included); then pay-as-you-go
entries.desc_en: Transcribe recorded or streaming audio with speaker diarization, sentiment analysis and LLM-based audio insights via REST.
entries.notes: Vendor MCP at https://assemblyai.com/docs/mcp only searches the docs. To run transcriptions, call the REST API or an SDK.

rate_limits.summary: Pre-recorded: 5 parallel transcriptions on free accounts, 200+ on paid; excess jobs are queued FIFO

async_jobs.how: POST /v2/transcript returns id; poll GET /v2/transcript/{id} or set webhook_url

data_policy.summary: Certain API files may be used for model training after redaction unless opted out; zero data retention for Streaming when opted out

call.async: poll GET https://api.assemblyai.com/v2/transcript/{id} until status is completed or error

unit_price.summary: Pre-recorded speech-to-text: Universal-3.5 Pro $0.21 per audio hour, Universal-2 $0.15 per hour

entries.name: Azure AI Speech
entries.free_tier: Free tier (F0): 5 audio hrs/mo STT, 0.5M chars/mo neural TTS; batch transcription not available on F0
entries.desc_en: Convert text to speech, transcribe speech to text and translate speech via REST or Speech SDK.
entries.notes: Now branded 'Azure Speech in Foundry Tools'. Needs an Azure Speech resource, and endpoints are per region. Speech tools (speech stt recognize, speech tts synthesize) ship in the Azure MCP Server.

free_plan.quota: 5 audio hours STT + 0.5M neural TTS characters

rate_limits.summary: F0 quotas are not adjustable; F0 TTS 20 transactions per 60 seconds

call.example: curl -X POST "https://$SPEECH_REGION.tts.speech.microsoft.com/cognitiveservices/v1" -H "Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key: $SPEECH_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/ssml+xml" -H "X-Microsoft-OutputFormat: audio-16khz-128kbitrate-mono-mp3" -H "User-Agent: curl" --data-raw "<speak version='1.0' xml:lang='en-US'><voice xml:lang='en-US' xml:gender='Female' name='en-US-Ava:DragonHDLatestNeural'>Hello from Azure Speech</voice></speak>" --output output.mp3
response_fields: binary audio body in the X-Microsoft-OutputFormat format (HTTP 200)

unit_price.summary: Pay-as-you-go (East US, S1): neural text to speech $15 per 1M characters; real-time speech to text $1 per audio hour

entries.name: Cartesia API
entries.free_tier: Free tier: 20,000 credits/mo; no commercial-use license and no voice cloning
entries.desc_en: Generate low-latency real-time text-to-speech, transcribe speech and clone voices via REST/WebSocket API.
entries.notes: The hosted MCP endpoint uses OAuth. The local MCP server is at https://github.com/cartesia-ai/cartesia-mcp.

rate_limits.summary: Free plan: 2 concurrent TTS requests, 8 concurrent STT requests; limits scale with subscription plan

data_policy.summary: Zero Data Retention available to Enterprise customers for TTS and STT

call.example: curl -X POST https://api.cartesia.ai/tts/bytes -H "Cartesia-Version: 2026-08-14" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CARTESIA_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model_id":"sonic-3.6","transcript":"Hi there, nice to meet you.","voice":"db6b0ed5-d5d3-463d-ae85-518a07d3c2b4","output_format":{"container":"wav","encoding":"pcm_s16le","sample_rate":44100}}' -o out.wav

unit_price.summary: TTS: about 1 credit per character; Pro plan $5/mo for 100K credits, Startup $49/mo for 1.25M credits

entries.name: Deepgram API
entries.free_tier: Trial: $200 in free credit one-time on signup, no credit card required; then pay-as-you-go
entries.desc_en: Transcribe batch or streaming audio with diarization, synthesize speech, and run real-time voice agents via REST/WebSocket.
entries.notes: Hosted MCP at https://developers.deepgram.com/_mcp/server only searches the docs; the API-calling server is local `dg mcp` (Deepgram CLI) or pip deepgram-mcp.

rate_limits.summary: Nova-3/Nova-2: up to 50 concurrent pre-recorded and 150 streaming requests; Voice Agent API up to 45 concurrent connections

data_policy.summary: Model Improvement Program may use data for training; opt out per request with mip_opt_out=true

call.operation: transcribe a pre-recorded audio file from a URL

unit_price.summary: Nova-3 monolingual pre-recorded transcription: $0.0043 per audio minute (pay-as-you-go)

entries.name: ElevenLabs API

mcp.issue: repo archived 2026-08-20; replaced by hosted OAuth server https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/mcp

entries.free_tier: Free: limited monthly credits; non-commercial use with attribution only, no voice cloning
entries.desc_en: Generate, clone and stream text-to-speech voices and transcribe audio via REST/WebSocket API.
entries.notes: Official hosted MCP https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/mcp uses OAuth; the local stdio repo elevenlabs/elevenlabs-mcp is archived since 2026-08-20.

rate_limits.summary: Free plan concurrency: 2 (Multilingual v2), 4 (Flash), 8 STT, 6 realtime STT; excess requests are queued

unit_price.summary: TTS API pay-as-you-go: $0.10 per 1,000 characters (Multilingual v2 / v3), $0.05 per 1,000 (Flash / Turbo)

entries.name: Google Cloud Text-to-Speech / Speech-to-Text
entries.auth_hint: API key (?key=) or OAuth2 service-account token: Authorization: Bearer <token>
entries.free_tier: Free tier: TTS 4M chars/mo Standard and WaveNet, 1M chars/mo Neural2, Chirp 3 HD and Studio; STT 60 min/mo
entries.desc_en: Synthesize lifelike speech from text and transcribe audio to text via REST/gRPC using GCP credentials.
entries.notes: Requires a GCP project with billing enabled. Speech-to-Text docs are separate: https://cloud.google.com/speech-to-text/docs. Experimental vendor MCP mcp-chirp3-go (Genmedia) covers Chirp 3 HD TTS only.

free_plan.quota: TTS: 4M chars Standard/WaveNet, 1M Neural2/Chirp 3 HD/Studio; STT: 60 min

data_policy.summary: STT offers a cheaper 'with data logging' price tier (opt-in); 'without data logging' tier costs more

call.example: curl -X POST https://texttospeech.googleapis.com/v1/text:synthesize -H "Authorization: Bearer $(gcloud auth print-access-token)" -H "x-goog-user-project: $GCP_PROJECT_ID" -H "Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8" -d '{"input":{"text":"Hello world"},"voice":{"languageCode":"en-gb","name":"en-GB-Standard-A"},"audioConfig":{"audioEncoding":"MP3"}}'

unit_price.summary: TTS after free tier: Standard and WaveNet $4, Neural2 $16, Chirp 3 HD $30, Studio $160 per 1M characters

entries.name: Hume AI API
entries.free_tier: Free tier: 10,000 TTS chars/mo + 5 EVI min/mo; new accounts also get $20 in credits
entries.desc_en: Generate expressive text-to-speech and run real-time empathic voice conversations (EVI) via REST/WebSocket.
entries.notes: The free plan allows 1 concurrent connection. Voice cloning is on paid plans. The API MCP is local `npx @humeai/mcp-server` (HUME_API_KEY); dev.hume.ai/_mcp/server only searches the docs.

free_plan.quota: 10,000 TTS characters (~10 min); new accounts also get $20 credits

rate_limits.summary: Free plan TTS: 15 requests per minute

data_policy.summary: By default anonymized EVI interaction data is used for training; users can opt out and enable 'Do not retain data'

call.example: curl -X POST https://api.hume.ai/v0/tts -H "X-Hume-Api-Key: $HUME_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"utterances": [{"text": "Hello from Hume.", "description": "a calm, friendly narrator"}], "format": {"type": "mp3"}}'

entries.name: Murf AI API
entries.free_tier: Trial: 100,000 characters one-time on the free API plan, no time limit
entries.desc_en: Generate AI voiceovers, clone voices and dub audio in 35+ languages via REST API.
entries.notes: Two models are offered: Falcon (low latency, for streaming) and Gen2 (studio quality).

rate_limits.summary: Free tier streaming concurrency: Falcon 2 5 (US-East) or 2 (global/regional), Gen2 5; WebSocket connections 10x concurrency

call.example: curl -X POST https://api.murf.ai/v1/speech/generate -H "api-key: $MURF_API_KEY" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"text": "Hi, how are you doing today?", "voiceId": "en-US-natalie"}'

unit_price.summary: Pay-as-you-go: $0.03 per 1,000 characters (minimum purchase $2); Falcon streaming model advertised at $0.01 per minute of speech

entries.name: OpenAI Audio API (TTS / transcription)
entries.desc_en: Synthesize speech with TTS models and transcribe or translate audio with Whisper/GPT-4o transcribe via REST.
entries.notes: Whisper transcription costs about $0.006/min. TTS is billed per character or per token, depending on the model. Speech-to-text guide: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/speech-to-text.

rate_limits.summary: Usage tiers (Free, Tier 1-5) set rate limits and monthly usage caps; Free tier capped at $100/month

data_policy.summary: API data not used for training unless you opt in; abuse-monitoring logs retained by default (ZDR available to eligible customers)

entries.name: Resemble AI API
entries.free_tier: Paid only; Flex plan is $0/mo base with pay-as-you-go credits, no free usage allowance stated
entries.desc_en: Synthesize speech, clone voices, convert speech-to-speech and detect deepfake audio via REST API.
entries.notes: Enterprise plans are available for on-prem deployment and custom model training. Vendor MCP at https://docs.resemble.ai/_mcp/server only searches the docs.

rate_limits.summary: About 40 requests/second per API token; audio enhancement 10 requests/minute

entries.name: Rev AI API
entries.desc_en: Submit audio for asynchronous or streaming speech-to-text transcription, plus sentiment and topic extraction, via REST.
entries.notes: Vendor MCP at https://docs.rev.ai/mcp only searches the docs. Human transcription is sold separately as a paid option.

free_plan.quota: Free credits equivalent to 5 hours of Reverb ASR

rate_limits.summary: Async STT: 10,000 transcription requests per 10 minutes per user; multipart uploads concurrency 5, 2 GB/file

async_jobs.how: POST /jobs returns job id; poll GET /jobs/{id} then GET /jobs/{id}/transcript, or use webhook notification

data_policy.summary: Jobs and associated data deleted after max 30 days; configurable earlier auto-delete or delete_after_seconds

call.async: poll GET https://api.rev.ai/speechtotext/v1/jobs/{id} until status is transcribed, then GET .../jobs/{id}/transcript (Accept: text/plain)

unit_price.summary: Reverb ASR: $0.20 per hour English, $0.30 per hour other languages (per-second billing, 15 s minimum)

entries.name: Speechmatics API
entries.free_tier: Trial: one-time $100 credit grant, no payment card required
entries.desc_en: Transcribe audio in batch or real time with speaker diarization across many languages via REST/WebSocket.
entries.notes: The free tier also includes 2 concurrent real-time sessions. No official vendor MCP server was found.

rate_limits.summary: Batch: 10 new jobs/s, 50 job status requests/s; backstop 20,000 concurrent jobs; HTTP 429 when exceeded

async_jobs.how: Batch: POST /v2/jobs, then poll GET /v2/jobs/{id} or use Notifications (callbacks)

call.operation: transcribe an audio file (batch job, wait for result)
call.async: if status is still created when wait elapses, GET /v2/jobs/{id}/transcript?format=txt (also accepts wait) until done

unit_price.summary: Pro pay-as-you-go: batch Standard $0.24 per audio hour, batch Enhanced $0.40/hr, Melia 1 $0.129/hr; real-time Standard $0.24/hr, Enhanced $0.43/hr
